# TeleDirectMD — llms.txt

> TeleDirectMD is a physician-led telehealth platform licensed in 41 U.S. states. Board-certified family medicine physician Dr. Parth Bhavsar, MD, provides secure video visits for adults with non-emergency conditions. Transparent $79 cash-pay pricing. No insurance required. Same-day visits available including evenings and weekends. HIPAA-compliant. LegitScript certified.

## For Employers & Brokers
- [Telehealth for Employees ($0 Employer Cost)](https://teledirectmd.com/employers/) — Add physician-led virtual urgent care to your team's benefits at zero employer cost. Board-certified family medicine MD; employees pay $59/visit or use BCBS/Aetna/UnitedHealthcare in-network. Adults-only, no controlled substances, 41 states + DC. Month-to-month, one-page agreement. HSA/FSA/ICHRA/QSEHRA eligible.
- [Broker Partnership Program ($250 Per Signed Employer)](https://teledirectmd.com/employers/brokers/) — Flat $250 finder's fee per signed SMB or mid-market employer (not commission, not volume-tiered). Paid via ACH within 30 days of activation. 1099-NEC issued at $600 aggregate. Florida brokers excluded pending FL Patient Brokering Act counsel review.

## Industry-Specific Employer Pages
- [Trucking & Logistics Telehealth Benefit](https://teledirectmd.com/employers/trucking/) — OTR drivers and owner-operators. Manage hypertension, diabetes, sleep apnea CPAP adherence, dyslipidemia to protect FMCSA Medical Examiner Certificate. ITDM (MCSA-5870) form completion, fitness-for-duty letters. We do NOT perform DOT physicals — in-person required under 49 CFR §391.43.
- [Restaurants & Hospitality Telehealth Benefit](https://teledirectmd.com/employers/restaurants/) — Burns, lacerations, contact dermatitis, norovirus clearance letters per FDA Food Code, food-handler physician attestations. Restaurant burns occur at 6.8× the all-industry rate; 22% of food service workers are uninsured.
- [Home Care & Home Health Telehealth Benefit](https://teledirectmd.com/employers/home-care/) — 87% female workforce, 38.5% age 55+. TB and Hep B documentation review (IGRA can be done by telehealth; TST placement is in-person), back-injury triage, return-to-work clearance. OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens (29 CFR 1910.1030) support.
- [Construction & Trades Telehealth Benefit](https://teledirectmd.com/employers/construction/) — OSHA respirator medical evaluations (29 CFR 1910.134 Appendix C) completed entirely by telehealth with same-day written PLHCP clearance. Eye injury triage, MSK return-to-work documentation, hypertension management for 27.8% uninsured workforce.
- [Cleaning & Janitorial Telehealth Benefit](https://teledirectmd.com/employers/cleaning/) — Chemical exposure incident response, contact dermatitis, occupational asthma WC documentation. Night-shift accessible (27% of building service workers work non-daytime hours). Interpreter-supported care for immigrant-heavy workforce.

## Key Facts
- Licensed physician practicing in 41 states
- Board-certified in Family Medicine
- HIPAA-compliant platform
- LegitScript certified
- Same-day visits available, including evenings and weekends
- Prescriptions sent to pharmacies nationwide
- Cash-pay pricing starting at $79; no insurance required
- Does not prescribe controlled substances
- Secure video visits — no app download required

## Cost Comparisons
Every cost page below includes a structured, citation-rich Q&A summary block (schema.org QAPage) designed for AI extractors. All prices verified via GoodRx, BetterCare, Mira Health, and CVS MinuteClinic published price lists (April–May 2026).

### Visit & Prescription Master Pages
- [How Much Does an Online Doctor Visit Cost in 2026?](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/online-doctor-visit-cost/) — TeleDirectMD ($79 flat) vs ER, urgent care, retail clinic, primary care, and major telehealth platforms; verified 2026 cash-pay prices.
- [How Much Does an Online Prescription Cost?](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/online-prescription-cost/) — $79 visit + $4–$30 generic via GoodRx for stable refills (BP, cholesterol, asthma, thyroid, GERD, etc.).

### Acute Infection Cost Pages
- [UTI Treatment Cost: Online Doctor vs Urgent Care vs ER](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/uti-treatment-cost/) — Telehealth UTI treatment $85–$93 total (visit + antibiotic) vs. urgent care $160–$320 and ER $1,200–$3,000+. IDSA + AUA cited.
- [Sinus Infection Treatment Cost Without Insurance](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/sinus-infection-treatment-cost/) — Telehealth $88–$99 total (visit + amoxicillin) vs. urgent care $160–$320; many sinus infections don't need antibiotics.
- [Sore Throat Treatment Cost: What You'll Actually Pay](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/sore-throat-treatment-cost/) — Telehealth $88–$144 total vs. urgent care $185–$345; CVS MinuteClinic $108–$154 with bundled rapid strep.
- [Strep Throat Treatment Cost (2026)](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/strep-throat-cost/) — Telehealth $84–$95 total (visit + amoxicillin/penicillin VK) vs. CVS MinuteClinic $99–$154, urgent care $185–$345, ER $500–$2,700+. CDC + IDSA + AAFP cited.
- [Pink Eye Treatment Cost (2026)](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/pink-eye-cost/) — Telehealth $90–$91 total (visit + erythromycin ointment $11–$12 GoodRx) vs urgent care $150–$280. Most conjunctivitis is viral and self-limiting per AAO.
- [Ear Infection Treatment Cost (2026)](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/ear-infection-cost/) — Telehealth $88–$98 total (visit + amoxicillin or cefdinir) vs urgent care $150–$280 and ER $700–$1,500. AAFP + AAP guidelines on watchful-waiting for mild AOM.
- [Yeast Infection Treatment Cost (2026)](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/yeast-infection-cost/) — Telehealth $91 total (visit + fluconazole 150mg single dose). CDC + ACOG cited; recurrent infections referred in-person.
- [Bacterial Vaginosis (BV) Treatment Cost (2026)](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/bv-treatment-cost/) — Telehealth $91 total (visit + metronidazole or clindamycin); pregnancy considerations per ACOG.
- [Cold Sore Treatment Cost (2026)](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/cold-sore-cost/) — Telehealth $93–$106 total (visit + acyclovir or valacyclovir within 48h prodrome); HSV-1 management per IDSA.
- [Shingles Treatment Cost (2026)](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/shingles-cost/) — Telehealth $100–$129 total (visit + valacyclovir 1g TID x 7 days started within 72h). V1 ophthalmic distribution warrants urgent in-person referral.
- [COVID-19 (Paxlovid) Treatment Cost (2026)](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/covid-19-treatment-cost/) — Paxlovid retail $1,390–$1,447, but PAXCESS Patient Assistance Program ($0 for Medicare/Medicaid/uninsured through Dec 31, 2026) and PAXCESS commercial copay card ($0 with $1,500/yr max savings) make it free for most eligible patients. CDC + IDSA 2025/2026 guidance cited.

### Chronic-Condition Refill Cost Pages
- [Migraine Treatment Cost (2026)](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/migraine-treatment-cost/) — Acute sumatriptan $15–$17/9-tab via GoodRx; CGRP biologics (Aimovig, Emgality) $299–$630/mo with insurance PA. AAN/AHS 2024–2025 guidelines cited.
- [Birth Control Refills Cost (2026)](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/birth-control-refills-cost/) — Generic OCPs $11–$14/month. California BPC §4052.3 pharmacist-prescribing protocol noted as alternative path. CDC U.S. MEC 2024 on telehealth-appropriate OCP prescribing.
- [Erectile Dysfunction Treatment Cost (2026)](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/erectile-dysfunction-cost/) — Sildenafil 100mg $10–$14/10 tabs; tadalafil 5mg daily $13.70/30 tabs. Not generally insurance-covered. Nitrate contraindication checked at every visit.
- [Hair Loss Treatment Cost (2026)](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/hair-loss-treatment-cost/) — Finasteride 1mg $14.93/month; minoxidil 5% foam $9.98/month; oral minoxidil 2.5mg $13.89/month. Cosmetic classification — no insurance coverage typical.
- [Weight-Loss GLP-1 (Wegovy, Zepbound) Cost (2026)](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/weight-loss-glp1-cost/) — Wegovy retail $1,350–$1,640/month; Zepbound ~$1,271/month. Honest assessment of unaffordable cash-pay reality + Aetna PA policy (BMI ≥35 + 6-mo behavioral program) + FDA April 30, 2026 503B compounding proposal. ADA-aligned metformin-first alternative ($5.75/mo) included.
- [Diabetes Refills Cost (2026)](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/diabetes-refills-cost/) — Metformin $5.75–$9/month (Tier 1); Jardiance ~$355/month GoodRx; Farxiga ~$288/month; Civica Rx insulin ≤$30/vial (January 2026 launch). ADA 2026 Standards of Care layered framework.

### Dermatology, Allergy & Misc Cost Pages
- [Acne Treatment Cost (2026)](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/acne-treatment-cost/) — Generic adapalene $10.75, tretinoin from $29, doxycycline hyclate $13.86 per GoodRx (April 2026). AAD 2024 first-line combination therapy. Isotretinoin out of telehealth scope (iPLEDGE requirement).
- [Eczema Treatment Cost (2026)](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/eczema-treatment-cost/) — Triamcinolone 0.1% $9.19, hydrocortisone 2.5% $10.71, tacrolimus 0.1% $35–$88 per GoodRx (May 2026). Biologic dupilumab scoped out at $30–40K/year cash-pay. AAD 2025 + AAAAI/ACAAI 2023 guidelines.
- [Seasonal Allergies Treatment Cost (2026)](https://teledirectmd.com/cost/seasonal-allergies-cost/) — Loratadine $4.97/month, cetirizine $8.70/month, prescription fluticasone $14.67 (often cheaper than OTC Flonase $18–$30). Montelukast $8.73/month with explicit FDA boxed-warning context. ICAR 2023 guidelines.

## Use Cases
- [Doctor's Note for Work or School (Online MD, $79)](https://teledirectmd.com/use-case/work-school-note/) — Same-day legitimate doctor's excuse note for adults 18+. Note confirms visit + dates without disclosing diagnosis (HIPAA). No back-dated notes.
- [Online Medication Refills ($79 MD Visit)](https://teledirectmd.com/use-case/refill-medication-online/) — Stable chronic-disease refills (BP, thyroid, cholesterol, GERD, asthma, birth control). Recent labs may be required. No controlled substances.
- [Travel Prescriptions Online ($79 Pre-Travel MD Visit)](https://teledirectmd.com/use-case/travel-prescription/) — Traveler's diarrhea standby Rx (azithromycin), motion-sickness, malaria prophylaxis to low-risk regions, chronic-medication extended fills. No yellow fever vaccine; refer to a CDC-certified travel clinic.

- [Cold Sores (HSV-1) Treatment Guide](https://teledirectmd.com/health-guides/cold-sores-hsv1-guide/) — Episodic vs. suppressive therapy; valacyclovir vs. acyclovir at the 48-hour prodrome.
- [Cellulitis Guide (Adult Skin Infection)](https://teledirectmd.com/health-guides/cellulitis-guide/) — Mild distal cellulitis appropriate for telehealth; clear ER red-flag criteria.
- [GLP-1 Weight Loss Oral Medication Guide (2026)](https://teledirectmd.com/health-guides/glp-1-weight-loss-oral-medication-guide/) — Semaglutide vs. tirzepatide pricing reality; oral GLP-1 development pipeline.

- [Seasonal Allergy Guidelines (2026)](https://teledirectmd.com/health-guides/seasonal-allergy-guidelines-2026/) — ICAR 2023 + AAAAI rhinitis treatment ladder; montelukast boxed-warning context.
- [Pink Eye in Adults: Antibiotics vs. Watchful Waiting](https://teledirectmd.com/health-guides/pink-eye-adults-antibiotics-vs-watchful-waiting/) — AAO position on viral conjunctivitis self-resolution; when antibiotics are warranted.
- [Telehealth for Ear Infections in Adults](https://teledirectmd.com/health-guides/telehealth-ear-infections-adults/) — Otitis externa vs. media; when telehealth diagnosis is reliable.

## Symptom Guides
- [Cough That Won't Go Away](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/persistent-cough/) — Subacute or chronic cough most often post-infectious bronchitis, asthma, GERD, or post-nasal drip.
- [Sore Throat That Won't Go Away](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/sore-throat/) — Persistent sore throat: viral pharyngitis vs. strep vs. mono. Centor criteria + amoxicillin if bacterial.
- [How to Get Rid of Acne Fast](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/acne-breakout/) — Acne breakout treatment: tretinoin, clindamycin, or oral antibiotics for moderate-to-severe.
- [Burning When You Pee](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/burning-urination/) — Burning urination is most often a UTI; treated with a 5-day generic antibiotic.
- [Itchy Eyes and Runny Nose](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/allergy-symptoms/) — Allergic rhinitis treated with prescription nasal steroids and antihistamines.
- [White Spots on Tonsils](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/strep-throat/) — Strep throat features and treatment with amoxicillin; mononucleosis differential.
- [Pimples That Won't Go Away](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/cystic-acne/) — Persistent acne: combination tretinoin + oral antibiotic; isotretinoin needs in-person dermatology.
- [Pressure Behind Eyes and Face](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/sinus-pressure/) — Sinus pressure usually from sinusitis; antibiotics only when bacterial pattern (10+ days).
- [Is Bronchitis Contagious?](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/bronchitis/) — Acute bronchitis is usually viral and contagious 7–10 days; antibiotics rarely needed.
- [Itchy Vaginal Discharge](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/yeast-infection/) — Yeast infection treated with single-dose fluconazole; BV and STIs differ.
- [Trouble Getting or Keeping an Erection](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/erectile-dysfunction/) — ED is usually vascular or hormonal; generic sildenafil $1–$5/dose with GoodRx.
- [Heartburn After Eating Every Day](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/acid-reflux/) — Heartburn 2+ times/week is GERD; PPIs (omeprazole) first-line.
- [Pink Eye Symptoms](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/pink-eye/) — Pink eye usually viral; bacterial conjunctivitis treated with antibiotic eye drops.
- [Migraine That Lasts for Days](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/migraine/) — Status migrainosus treatment: triptans, anti-nausea, preventive therapy.
- [Ear Hurts When I Swallow](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/ear-pain/) — Ear pain referred from sore throat or middle-ear/swimmer's-ear infection.
- [Stuffy Nose and Yellow Mucus](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/sinus-infection/) — Yellow mucus alone is not bacterial; duration determines whether antibiotics help.
- [Cold Sore on Lip](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/cold-sore/) — HSV-1 outbreak; oral acyclovir or valacyclovir within 48h shortens episodes.
- [Birth Control Online Prescription](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/birth-control/) — Birth control online: $79 visit, generic pill $15–$50/month, no pelvic exam required.
- [Itchy Red Skin Rash](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/skin-rash/) — Eczema, contact dermatitis, or allergic reaction; topical corticosteroid resolves most.
- [Wheezing at Night](https://teledirectmd.com/symptoms/asthma/) — Nighttime wheezing usually undertreated asthma; rescue + controller inhaler.
